description: Meet Monica at the National Council of Jewish Women Colorado Candidates’ Fair! Stop by to say hello, ask your questions, and learn more about her campaign for House District 9. The in-person Candidates’ Fair meet-and-greet runs from 6:30 to 7:30 PM. It’s followed by the Candidates’ Forum from 7:30
paid_for_by: Paid for by Monica for Colorado
title: NCJW Colorado Candidates' Fair and Forum — Monica for Colorado
